name: Fuse
author: Erin Carter
description: Two thin fuse cords cross the dark frame on shallow diagonals; a white-hot bead chews along each at its own jittering speed, ringed by a warm-to-cool halo and throwing sparks, leaving ash behind and dark cord ahead.

params.label: Burn speed
params.effect: Base fraction of a cord each bead consumes per second; the speed jitter rides on top of this.

params.label: Halo width
params.effect: Radius in CSS px of the colour-graded halo around the burn bead.

params.label: Spark spray
params.effect: Density of spark flecks thrown off each bead; 0 leaves clean ember points.

params.label: Cord waviness
params.effect: How far the cords bow away from straight lines; 0 lays them perfectly straight.
